LESSON: CREATION OF

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: My By the end of the sub strand, the learner ●Learners to read Acts 10:2 1. Who 
Topic 1.3: Creation of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creation of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. draw the sun, moon and stars to appreciate God’s creation kabisa………..’

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. draw the sun, moon and stars to appreciate God’s creation kabisa………..’
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to draw the sun, moon and stars to appreciate God’s creation kabisa………..’. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creation of.
2. Explain Creation of to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: In groups, learners to list the importance of reading1.
4. Show that you can: draw the sun, moon and stars to appreciate God’s creation kabisa………..’
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creation of. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creation of important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners to list the importance of reading1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. draw the sun, moon and stars to appreciate God’s creation kabisa………..’

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
